Also, ensure character names are not confused with voice types (e.g., "mezzo soprano Manon Lescaut" is incorrect).

   - *Botanical and ecological distribution:* Teide National Park (founded 1943) is on Tenerife in the Canary Islands. Echium wildpretii subspecies have distinct island distributions (e.g., subsp. trichosiphon on La Palma in La Caldera de Taburiente National Park, a separate park established 1954). Queries must clarify species distribution and park locations.
